name: Timed-operation qualifier
summary: A timed-operation qualifier identifies operation influenced by the documented timing function.
description: A timed-operation qualifier identifies operation influenced by the documented timing function. A timing relationship describes when an action follows an initiating event. It does not decide whether the timing continues after the input disappears or how the function resets.
Document the input transition, the timed output and the intended timing mode. The main contact or actuator representation still supplies the resulting state.
readingNotes: State the trigger, timing mode and reset condition separately.
A generic timing indication does not distinguish on-delay, off-delay or pulse operation.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
State the trigger, timing mode and reset condition separately.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
distinction: A generic timing indication does not distinguish on-delay, off-delay or pulse operation.
